_meta.description: National House results by cycle: Democratic share of the two-party vote and Democratic seats won. Inputs to scripts/fit_seat_conversion.py.
_meta.source: Compiled from public records (Clerk of the U.S. House official election statistics). Vote shares are two-party (D/(D+R)); seat counts are seats won in the November general. Verify against the Clerk's statistics when appending a new cycle.
_meta.caveat: dem_two_party_pct values are rounded to 0.1pp from published national totals; treat as accurate to ~0.2pp.
